import os, hashlib, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(os.environ['NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR']).parent / 'inbox'
files = ['checkpoint.json', 'provider.json']
before = {n: hashlib.sha256((p/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in files}
r = subprocess.run(['python3', '-B', './soodles.py', 'landing', 'advance', str(p/'checkpoint.json'), str(p/'provider.json')], text=True, capture_output=True)
print('exit_code:', r.returncode)
print(r.stdout)
print(r.stderr)
after = {n: hashlib.sha256((p/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in files}
print({'before': before, 'after': after, 'unchanged': before == after})
